main_text.p: fe vidisse refert pilam plumbeam infundo bombardæ oblongæ aeris dućtum sequi, tanto impetu, ut ex foramine siphonis seu ostio prorumpens, fugenti dentes effregerit. Secundo loco po-nit Attractionem vini vel aquæ, quæ Siphonis operâ peragitur, quam tamen cum præcedente plane convenire ait: interveniente hujus attractionis auxilio liquor unius vasis in aliud ita qui-dem transferri posse, notum est, ut nec perturbetur, nec fœces ejus adscendant. 3. Aliam infuper Attractionis spe-ciei est, ait, quæ Magnetica appella-tur; per quam nimirum Magnes ferrum attrahit. 4. Aliam Electricam, quando scilicet succinum paleam attrahit; 5. Et iterum aliam flammæ attractionem dari; quâ fumum candelæ ex-tinctæ flammam lucentis attrahere confpicimus 6. Aliam adhuc esse, quæ per Filtrationem fieri consuevit; ubi corpus humidum per aliud siccum adscendit, aut contrarium evenit. 6. Denique 7.

page.notes: Several words are set in a worn or blurred print; the Greek-free Latin has been read with some doubtful letters, e.g. "Electricam", "spe-ciei", "adscendant" and "Denique 7" were not fully certain. Italics are approximated from the scan. Page number not printed.
